rounds.reviewer: codex gpt-5.6-sol ultra (candidate-finding pass, full-collection resweep) + Claude Sonnet 5 (independent adversarial verification pass in a separate thread, tried to refute every candidate)
rounds.summary: 2026-07-12 全集重扫复审：Codex GPT-5.6-sol 一轮候选 + Claude Sonnet 5 对抗验证（尝试推翻每条）→ 0 REFUTED，10 CONFIRMED + 3 NEEDS_NUANCE，全部已修复，含 2 处教学代码块的真实逻辑 bug（RowParallelLinear 初始化用了本地分片 fan_in、train_step_4d 在非末 stage 因空列表崩溃）。
issues: 20 CONFIRMED §6.2 hpZ: described as '节点内 8 张 GPU 各持完整 weight（hpZ=节点内 DDP）' — actually a secondary ZeRO-3-style partition, each GPU adds only Φ/H not full Φ

21 CONFIRMED §6.3/§6.4 qgZ: gradient reduce-scatter described as INT8 — ZeRO++ paper uses INT4 (4-bit); the reported 4× traffic reduction is qwZ(2×)+hpZ(cross-node all-gather eliminated)+qgZ(4×) combined, not '2×(int8) times 2 primitives'

22 CONFIRMED §7.4 RowParallelLinear.__init__: nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.weight) let PyTorch auto-derive fan_in from the LOCAL sharded shape (in_per_rank), inflating init variance by T× — real code bug, fixed to compute bound from the global in_features

23 NEEDS_NUANCE §9.2/§9.3: 'GPipe activation memory grows linearly with M' is standard under a fixed micro-batch size (1F1B paper's convention, kept), but under a fixed total mini-batch B split into M pieces it's actually O(B) independent of M — added a clarifying note, no rewrite

24 CONFIRMED §2.2/§7.5: H100 NVLink 4.0 900 GB/s table entry mislabeled as unidirectional under a '单向带宽' header — it's the bidirectional aggregate; unidirectional ≈450 GB/s; corrected the 4GB transfer estimate from ≈4.4ms to ≈8.9ms
25 CONFIRMED §5.1 table: 'FSDP1 同 unit 内必须全冻或全可训' stated unconditionally — only true for default use_orig_params=False; use_orig_params=True allows mixed frozen/trainable (LoRA use case)
26 NEEDS_NUANCE §15.1: 'FSDP1 与 TP 几乎不可复合' overstated — engineering-hard (flat-buffer vs TP shard-axis conflict), not mathematically impossible; softened wording

27 NEEDS_NUANCE §7.3 callout + Q6 trap: framed 'shard by head' vs 'shard hidden_dim' as mutually exclusive with the latter flatly wrong — hidden_dim can be sharded as long as the boundary aligns with whole heads; the actual bug is splitting a single head's d_head across ranks

28 CONFIRMED §4.4/§12.3: ZeRO-Infinity described as 'mainly for inference/fine-tuning' — the SC 2021 paper's design goal is training trillion-parameter models under limited GPU count, not inference/fine-tuning

29 CONFIRMED §A: build_4d_model / heading labeled '4D parallelism (PP×FSDP×CP×TP)' while mesh_shape=(2,4,1,8) has CP=1 (never enabled, no CP sharding applied to attention) — relabeled as 3D (PP×FSDP×TP+SP) with CP as a placeholder dim

30 CONFIRMED §A train_step_4d: unconditional torch.stack(losses).mean() crashes with RuntimeError on every non-last pipeline stage, since torch.distributed.pipelining only populates `losses` on the last stage — real code bug, fixed to guard on len(losses) > 0 and return None otherwise
31 CONFIRMED §9.6: PP per-transfer size formula B/M·L·D given in 'bytes' is actually an element count, missing the per-element byte factor q (q=2 for fp16/bf16)

32 CONFIRMED §3.3 DDP code comment: static_graph=False annotated as '启用更多 fusion' — actual benefit is skipping the per-iteration unused-parameter traversal and enabling cross-iteration grad accumulation / multi-backward, not kernel fusion
